name: Hot cumin lamb wrap with crunchy slaw & spicy mayo
assumptions: Yield estimated from 4 pitas and 4 lamb steaks as 4 servings
Total time is approximate active/prep+cook time based on instructions (griddling 6-8 min + quick prep and assembly); no explicit total given
Mayonnaise assumed to contain egg (standard unless specified otherwise)
Pita bread assumed to contain wheat (standard unless certified gluten-free)
Peppadew peppers assumed jarred in vinegar brine (no allergens added)
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, sesame, or soy confidently detected
Lamb, oil, cumin, sugar, vinegar, carrots, spring onions, cabbage are allergen-free
instructions:
step 1
Heat a griddle pan. Rub the lamb steaks with the oil, cumin and some seasoning. Griddle for about 3-4 mins on each side or until cooked to your liking. Place to one side on a plate to rest.

step 2
In a large bowl, stir the sugar into the vinegar until dissolved. Add the carrots, spring onions, cabbage and some seasoning, and toss together.

step 3
Blitz the whole peppers and the mayo in a food processor. Add a heap of the salad to each flatbread. Slice the lamb, trimming off any excess fat and lay on top of the salad, drizzling with the resting juices. Spoon over the mayo and scatter with a few of the sliced peppers. Roll up and eat. If using pitta, split and stuff. Serve any extra salad on the side.

ingredients.name: Lamb Leg
ingredients.assumptions: 4 small lamb leg steaks total ~800g raw edible portion based on typical 200g per small steak; raw values used as lamb is griddled briefly then rested.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp olive oil; standard density ~5g per tsp.

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp ground cumin; typical weight for 1 tsp spice.

ingredients.name: White Wine Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar; ~15g per tbsp, negligible macros.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium carrots, raw, edible portion ~80g each; typical recipe size.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 spring onions, sliced; typical ~15g each raw edible.

ingredients.name: White Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: 400g white cabbage as given; raw values, used in slaw.

ingredients.name: Sweet Peppadew Peppers
ingredients.assumptions: 5 sweet Peppadew peppers; typical drained jarred weight ~20g each, whole used in mayo and garnish.

ingredients.name: Mayonnaise
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons mayonnaise; ~15g per tbsp, standard full-fat.

ingredients.name: Pita Bread
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large pita breads; typical 60g each, used as wraps.
